{'text': 'Following the Queen Mary Hospital escalator trough incident, another lift engineering project is suspected of cutting corners. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department stated on Thursday (the 15th) evening that it received a report alleging irregularities by Tai Nicchi Elevator (Hong Kong) Company Limited. It conducted a surprise inspection and found that when the company replaced 48 lifts at Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin and Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong, it did not install door frame assemblies for fire-resistant doors, yet submitted fire-resistance reports. The EMSD does not rule out that the incident involves fraud and provision of false declarations, and will refer the case to the Police for follow-up. The Housing Authority stated that it will hold Tai Nicchi accountable.', 'paragraph_context': '繼瑪麗醫院斜𨋢槽事件後，再有升降機工程涉偷工減料。機電工程署周四（15日）晚表示，接獲舉報指，臺日電梯（香港）有限公司涉嫌有違規行為，進行突擊巡查，發現該公司在沙田博康邨及觀塘翠屏（北）邨，更換 48 部升降機時，沒安裝耐火門的門框組件，卻提交耐火報告。機電署不排除事件涉及欺詐和提供虛假陳述，會轉介警務處跟進。房委會表示會追究臺日責任。 事件由中科監察主席潘焯鴻日前在網上踢爆，並指在工程投標時，房署以較大的業權份數，影響投票結果，最終選擇了臺日電梯。《集誌社》已向房署查詢。'}

{'text': 'The incident was exposed online a few days ago by Tony Poon, Chairman of the China Construction Monitor, and he said that during the tendering of the project, the Housing Department used a larger share of ownership to influence the voting result, ultimately selecting Tai Nicchi Elevator. The Collective has already made enquiries with the Housing Department.', 'paragraph_context': '繼瑪麗醫院斜𨋢槽事件後，再有升降機工程涉偷工減料。機電工程署周四（15日）晚表示，接獲舉報指，臺日電梯（香港）有限公司涉嫌有違規行為，進行突擊巡查，發現該公司在沙田博康邨及觀塘翠屏（北）邨，更換 48 部升降機時，沒安裝耐火門的門框組件，卻提交耐火報告。機電署不排除事件涉及欺詐和提供虛假陳述，會轉介警務處跟進。房委會表示會追究臺日責任。 事件由中科監察主席潘焯鴻日前在網上踢爆，並指在工程投標時，房署以較大的業權份數，影響投票結果，最終選擇了臺日電梯。《集誌社》已向房署查詢。'}

{'text': 'Housing Authority: To hold Tai Nicchi accountable', 'paragraph_context': '房委會：追究臺日責任'}

{'text': 'The Housing Authority issued a statement on Thursday evening stating that, having been notified by the EMSD, it is highly concerned about the incident and will follow up seriously, holding Tai Nicchi accountable. The Housing Authority stated that, among the Tenants Purchase Scheme estates, only the two estates mentioned above currently have lift replacement projects undertaken by Tai Nicchi. Another estate, which is also preparing for lift replacement, Fu Heng Estate, has not yet had a contract awarded. The Housing Authority has recommended that the owner-formed body of Fu Heng Estate suspend the awarding of the contract.', 'paragraph_context': '房委會周四晚出稿表示，接獲機電署通知，對事件表示高度關注，會嚴肅跟進事件，追究臺日責任。房委會表示，租置屋邨中，暫只有上述兩屋邨由臺日承辦更換升降機工程。另一正籌備更換升降機的富亨邨，尚未批出合約。房委會已建議富亨邨業主立案法團暫緩批出合約。'}

{'text': "Residents of Fu Heng Estate held a special owners' meeting in September this year, during which owners debated the Housing Authority's selection of the lift replacement contractor. Some residents questioned that the Housing Department used a larger share of ownership to enable Tai Nicchi Elevator to win the tender, but were concerned about the company's capabilities.", 'paragraph_context': '富亨邨居民在今年九月，曾召開特別業主大會，有業主就房委會在更換升降機承辦商選擇提出爭論。有居民質疑房署以較大的業權份數，令臺日電梯中標，但擔心這公司的能力。'}

{'text': 'The Housing Department replied to residents on October 2, stating that the voting decision was made after analysis from multiple perspectives. Having learnt that some had expressed concerns about Tai Nicchi\'s capabilities, it pointed out that Tai Nicchi had already issued a statement on September 29 responding to the untrue remarks about the company circulating online. Subsequently, Tai Nicchi was exposed for "replacing lift doors but not replacing door frames" in other projects. The Housing Authority stated on Thursday (the 15th) that it has recommended that the owner-formed body of Fu Heng Estate suspend the awarding of the contract', 'paragraph_context': '房署在 10 月 2 日曾回覆居民指，從多角度分析作投票決定。得悉有人對臺日的能力表示關注，指臺日已在 9.29 發聲明，就網上流傳該公司不實言論作回應。及後臺日被揭在其他工程「換𨋢門唔換框」。房委會在周四（15日）表示，已建議富亨邨業主立案法團暫緩批出合約'}

{'text': 'Tai Nicchi Elevator replaced nine lifts for Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong.', 'paragraph_context': '臺日電梯為觀塘翠屏（北）邨更換九部升降機。'}

{'text': 'Our reporter saw at the scene today that at Tsui Ping North Estate in Kwun Tong, other lifts have been taken out of service and are being prepared for replacement.', 'paragraph_context': '記者今日現場所見，觀塘翠屏北邨，有其他升降機暫停使用，正準備更換。'}

{'text': 'Door frame assemblies not installed yet reported as completed', 'paragraph_context': '沒安裝門框組件卻報稱完工'}

{'text': 'Tai Nicchi replaced 39 lifts at Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin between May last year and July this year, and nine lifts at Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong between February and July this year. However, for these 48 lifts, only fire-resistant doors were installed, with no door frame assemblies, yet it reported the work as completed and submitted fire-resistance performance test reports for the fire-resistant doors and door frame assemblies. The EMSD stated that the construction contains serious defects.', 'paragraph_context': '臺日在去年五月至今年七月，在沙田博康邨更換 39 部升降機，今年二月至七月，在觀塘翠屏（北）邨更換九部升降機。不過，這48 部升降機時，只安裝了耐火門，沒安裝門框組件，卻報稱完工，及就耐火門和門框組件，提交耐火效能測試報告。機電工程署指，施工存在嚴重缺失。'}

{'text': 'EMSD sets a one-month limit for completion of remedial works', 'paragraph_context': '機電署限一個月內完成執修'}

{'text': 'The EMSD stated that these lifts can still operate safely, but the absence of such door frame assemblies constitutes a violation. The EMSD said it has instructed Tai Nicchi to conduct a re-inspection and promptly install the missing door frame assemblies, bearing all costs related to the remedial measures, with the remedial works to be completed within one month.', 'paragraph_context': '機電工程署指，這些升降機仍可安全運作，但沒有該等門框組件，屬於違規。機電署表示，已指令臺日覆檢及盡快安裝缺欠的門框組件，承擔補救措施的所有相關費用，一個月內完成執修工程。'}

{'text': 'Fraud and provision of false declarations not ruled out', 'paragraph_context': '不排除涉及欺詐和提供虛假陳述'}

{'text': 'The EMSD said it anticipates that adding door frames to each lift can be completed within one to two days. During the works, the lifts must be taken out of service, and the works will be arranged during off-peak hours as far as possible. The EMSD stated that preliminary evidence indicates that Tai Nicchi is suspected of serious negligence or misconduct, and that enforcement will be carried out under the Lifts and Escalators Ordinance. Fraud and provision of false declarations are not ruled out, and the case will be referred to the Police for follow-up.', 'paragraph_context': '機電署指，預料每部升降機，可在一至兩天內完成加裝門框。工程期間，升降機須暫停運作，會盡量在非繁忙時間進行工程。機電署指，初步證據顯示，臺日涉嫌觸犯嚴重疏忽或行為不當，會根據《升降機及自動梯條例》執法，不排除涉及欺詐和提供虛假陳述，會轉介警務處跟進。'}

{'text': 'The EMSD will complete inspections of all lifts installed by Tai Nicchi across Hong Kong within three days, reviewing fire-resistance performance test reports for fire-resistant doors and their door frame components, and checking whether door frame assemblies have been omitted. The EMSD has also inspected lift engineering projects of other registered lift contractors and has not found similar situations for the time being.', 'paragraph_context': '機電署會在三日內完成巡查全港由臺日安裝的升降機，覆檢耐火門及其門框部件的耐火效能測試報告，及核查是否出現門框組件漏裝。機電署也有巡查其他註冊升降機承辦商的升降機工程，暫無發現類似情況。'}

{'text': "Information on Tai Nicchi's website shows that as of mid-this year, the company maintains over 1,300 lifts. Last year, the number of lift replacement projects in Hong Kong was about 280, and as of 2026, the number of replacement projects has reached around 300. Zhang Qin is a shareholder and director of Tai Nicchi, and other directors include Zhang Chonghao and Zhang Chongpei. Zhang Qin is a director of three other companies, including one named Hong Kong Hingshi Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.", 'paragraph_context': '臺日的網頁資料顯示，至今年中，該公司保養逾 1300 部電梯。去年度在香港所更新電梯工程約 280 台，至2026年今更新項目達 300 台左右。張欽是臺日的公司股東兼董事，其他董事包括張重⾼、張重沛。張欽是另外三間公司的董事，包括一間名為香港興世機械制造有限公司。'}
